open_points.subject: Pre-send instance failure detail ownership (`instance_not_selected` vs `instance_address_missing`)
open_points.text: "`bindings.check_binding_current` returns ... the `base_url`, `required_headers` and `instance_class` ... absent when none is selected" and "At send `service_invoker` judges only the instance facts the ManifestOperation carries, and reads nothing from `installation` but the credential."
open_points.question: How can `service_invoker` deterministically choose between `instance_not_selected` and `instance_address_missing` (A09/A10) if it only receives ManifestOperation instance facts that may be absent in both cases?
options: `bindings.check_binding_current` returns an explicit instance-state reason (`not_selected` vs `address_missing`) along with ManifestOperation
`service_invoker` is allowed to read selected-instance presence from `installation` at send time
Collapse both into one failure detail despite A10 naming both
open_points.default_guess: Have `bindings.check_binding_current` return an explicit pre-send instance-state reason so `service_invoker` stays installation-blind except credential resolution.

open_points.subject: HTTP method closed set ownership
open_points.text: "Closed sets that are a model's — classes, statuses, HTTP methods — are `models` enumerations"
open_points.question: Where is the HTTP-method closed set actually owned and exposed, given State 1 M10 lists `http_method` as a field but does not define a model enumeration for methods while A08 rule 3 constrains valid methods?
options: Define an HTTP method enumeration in `models` and have `bindings`/`service_invoker` consume it
Keep method set local to `bindings`/`service_invoker` as non-model constants
open_points.default_guess: Define the method set in `models` as an enumeration and consume it from `bindings` and `service_invoker`.
